title: NIH Forms I G.400 - PHS 398 Research Plan Form

transformation.method: manual deterministic selection of instruction statements into ordered JSON records
normalization: HTML navigation and presentation markup omitted
instruction meaning, applicability, and numeric limits preserved

records.label: Introduction to Application (for Resubmission and Revision applications)
records.applicability: Required for resubmission and revision applications or when the NOFO requires it; not allowed for new or renewal applications. Multi-project component rules vary.

records.label: Specific Aims
records.applicability: Required unless the NOFO specifies otherwise.

records.label: Vertebrate Animals
records.applicability: Required when the R&R Other Project Information response says vertebrate animals are used; multi-project overall-component rules vary.

records.label: Select Agent Research
records.applicability: Include when proposed activities use select agents during the project period.

records.label: Multiple PD/PI Leadership Plan
records.applicability: Required when the application designates multiple PD/PIs and prohibited otherwise.

records.label: Consortium/Contractual Arrangements
records.applicability: Include when the budget contains consortium or contractual arrangements.

records.label: Letters of Support
records.applicability: Combine applicable letters into one role-specific document; do not place them in the Appendix.

records.label: Resource Sharing Plan(s)
records.applicability: Include applicable model-organism and research-tool sharing plans.

records.label: Other Plan(s)
records.applicability: Include a Data Management and Sharing Plan when the activity code, proposed scientific data, and NOFO make the policy applicable.

records.label: Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources
records.applicability: Include when key biological or chemical resources are applicable to the proposed science.

records.label: Appendix
records.applicability: Optional; include only policy-allowed appendix materials and follow any conflicting NOFO instructions.

knownSourceConflicts.xsd: AttachmentGroupMin0Max100DataType permits zero through 100 AttachedFile records.
knownSourceConflicts.applicantInstructions: The DAT and NIH Forms I guide permit up to 10 PDF files.
knownSourceConflicts.disposition: The applicant JSON Schema enforces 10; the XML profile remains valid within the XSD's 100-record technical envelope.

knownSourceConflicts.applicantInstructions: Specific Aims is required unless the NOFO specifies otherwise.
knownSourceConflicts.disposition: The standalone form keeps the field optional until NOFO-aware application policy can express the exception without over-restricting submissions.

knownSourceConflicts.detail: The source XSD declares its PHS398_ResearchPlan_5_0 prefix with a V4.0 URI while targetNamespace is V5.0.
knownSourceConflicts.disposition: The XML profile uses the authoritative V5.0 targetNamespace and does not copy the erroneous alias URI.
